--部品番号 --部品名 --単位 --構成数 --総必要数 --在庫数 --不足数 --不良 --保留 --有効在庫
SELECT itm.item_id AS itemId, itm.item_name AS itemName, itm.unit AS unit, bmm.quantity AS calcQuantity, bcr.gross_qty AS calcTotalRequired, stm.stock_quantity AS calcStockQty, bcr.net_qty AS calcShortageQty, stm.defective_quantity AS calcDefectiveQty, stm.hold_quantity AS calcHoldQty, bcr.available_stock AS calcAvailableQty FROM bom_calc_result bcr INNER JOIN bom_master bmm ON bcr.item_id = bmm.parent_id AND bmm.parent_id = #{parentId} AND bcr.calc_id = #{calcId} LEFT JOIN stock_master stm ON bcr.item_id = stm.item_id LEFT JOIN item_master itm ON bcr.item_id = itm.item_id
